generation_review.full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D06C.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
EXACT STRUCTURAL READING:
1. Only THX and DYC available; CCZ/QJZ unavailable. Upper and lower components separate with a clear gap.
2. Upper outer component is ONE rounded open-top U-bowl, its two upward side tips free. Inside is ONE horizontal attached to LEFT bowl side but ending FREELY BEFORE the RIGHT side. Preserve a substantial visible gap at the bar's RIGHT tip; the lower bowl field is OPEN through that right channel, not a closed counter.
3. Above that horizontal, inside/between the U-side tips, is a fully DETACHED peaked chevron: two sloping arms joined at central apex plus SHORT upward tick at apex. Both arm tips remain separated from U-side tips and from inner horizontal.
4. Lower component is THREE horizontal bars joined by ONE vertical stem, starting on upper bar and ending on baseline. Baseline longest, upper next, middle shortest; lower vertical gap larger than upper. No vertical protrusion above/below outer bars.
5. Lower baseline is wider than upper bowl; bowl about75–85% of baseline width. No connection between upper bowl and lower bars. Entire glyph has NO closed counter because upper inner bar stops short of right rim.
Critical gap: upper bowl's INNER HORIZONTAL HAS A FREE RIGHT TIP, visibly short of right wall. Do not close it into a counter! Roof chevron with upward tick is completely separate from bowl and inner bar. Compare both THX and DYC equally. Uniform thin technical-pen strokes with round caps; no brush swelling.
